body:
GitHub issue #307.

## Problem (as reported vs. as found)

#307 reports that `plugins/adlc-pi/index.js`'s `shellHasMutation` (index.js:74)
carries the whitespace-anchored redirect regex that was the pre-#290 rail-bypass
(`cat a>rail` — no space before `>` — misclassified read-only), and asks to port
`hasUnquotedFileRedirect` from `@adlc/core` into it.

Investigation shows the premise is stale. pi's LIVE enforcement path does not use
`index.js` at all:

- The pi extension entry is `./index.ts` (declared via package.json
  `pi.extensions`; the publish surface is the `files` allowlist, which lists
  `index.ts`+`lib/` and NOT `index.js`, so a published `@adlc/pi` never
  contains it). `index.ts` delegates to `./lib/extension.mjs`.
- The live shell decision is `plugins/adlc-pi/lib/rails-checker.mjs`
  `checkShellCommand`, which imports `classifyShellCommand` from `@adlc/core`
  (the single source of truth per ADR-0004). `@adlc/core`'s classifier ALREADY
  has `hasUnquotedFileRedirect` wired into `shellHasMutation`
  (packages/core/lib/shell.mjs:100) and dedicated regression coverage
  (packages/core/test/shell.test.mjs:143-171: `cat a>rail`, quoted no-space
  targets, `2>&1` / quoted-`>` negatives).
- `index.js` is imported by nothing (`grep` across lib/, test/, and the repo
  finds no importer). It was last touched only incidentally in e8082ed (#180)
  and is a vestigial pre-`lib/` monolith.

So the vulnerable regex survives ONLY in dead code. Porting a fix into it would
edit an unreachable file and add a vacuously-passing test while changing nothing
about live enforcement. The reported in-session bypass is not reachable through
pi's runtime today; the `rails-guard-ci` diff gate remains the backstop
regardless.

## Required behavior

1. Delete `plugins/adlc-pi/index.js` (dead, superseded by `index.ts` ->
   `lib/*.mjs`). This removes the only copy of the vulnerable classifier in the
   pi tree and the drift surface #307 flagged.
2. Add a guard test that fails if pi ever reintroduces a local shell-mutation
   classifier instead of importing `@adlc/core`. The invariant: pi carries no
   second copy of the shell classifier that could drift from canonical. This is
   the durable answer to #307's 'pi is not pinned to @adlc/core by a drift test'
   concern — with `index.js` gone, the live path imports core directly, so the
   only way drift returns is a new local copy, which the guard forbids.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `plugins/adlc-pi/index.js` no longer exists. Verify: the file is absent and
   `git ls-files` does not list it.
2. A new test in `plugins/adlc-pi/test/` asserts no tracked pi source file
   (outside an `@adlc/core` import) defines its own `shellHasMutation` or the
   whitespace-anchored redirect classifier regex. Verify: the test is RED if a
   local `function shellHasMutation` / redirect-regex copy is added to any
   `plugins/adlc-pi/**` source file, GREEN once only the `@adlc/core` import
   remains.
3. The guard scans a non-empty, glob-discovered file set (fails loudly rather
   than passing vacuously if the glob matches nothing).
4. pi's live enforcement is unchanged: `checkShellCommand` still routes through
   `@adlc/core classifyShellCommand`, and pi's existing rails/reactive-gate
   tests stay green.
5. Full pi test segment green (`node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs`),
   and `npm run preflight` green.

## Constraints

- Do NOT change `@adlc/core` behavior; it is already fixed and covered.
- Do NOT add a second inline classifier to pi. The whole point is single-source.
- Scope is limited to removing dead code and adding the guard; no change to the
  live `lib/` enforcement logic.
title: adlc-pi: delete the dead index.js monolith carrying the pre-#290 shell classifier
